Container.Name: steelbook-tracker
Container.Overview: Tracks upcoming 4K steelbook announcements and preorders (from Blu-ray.com) and what the Gruv, Lionsgate Limited and MVD shops have in stock, sends alerts to Home Assistant, and lets you tick off what you've bought.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the tracker web page

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Address of this web UI, linked from notifications, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8787

Config.Name: Shops to watch
Config.Description: Shops whose own 4K steelbook listings are watched: gruv, lionsgate, mvd. Use none to watch no shop.

Config.Name: Check shops every (minutes)
Config.Description: How often the shops are read (minimum 10; minimum 60 when they are read with a browser)

Config.Name: How the shops are read
Config.Description: feed asks each shop for its product list directly. browser opens each shop's page in Chromium inside the container instead; it is still a bot to the shops and can be refused too. Read "Reading the shops with a browser" in the README before choosing it.

Config.Name: News headlines
Config.Description: Add HD Report's steelbook headlines to the daily digest (true or false)
